title: #079. Operating Room Surgical Case & Overtime Allocation
subtitle: Assign surgical cases to compatible operating rooms and sessions balancing priority scores against capped overtime penalties.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { assignedRoom, assignedSession, overtime, netScore }.
judge.m2: Case {p0} assignment (room={p1}, session={p2}) must be (-1, -1) or valid indices.
judge.m3: Case {p0} cannot be assigned to incompatible operating room {p1}.
judge.m4: Overtime in room {p0}, session {p1} ({p2}) exceeds allowed range [0, {p3}].
judge.m5: Room {p0}, session {p1} load ({p2}) exceeds regular capacity plus overtime ({p3}).
judge.m6: Reported netScore ({p0}) does not match computed priority minus overtime cost ({p1}).
judge.m7: Valid surgical plan, but net score ({p0}) is below maximum ({p1}).
